g.text: Ticket Loop - Planning, Dependencies and Delivery
Then define ordered Slices inside each Ticket
Reuse unique matches or create Issues
Parent plan -> all initial Tickets -> parent index
Persist Status / Branch / Base / Dependencies / PR
Keep created Issue links; no local ticket mirror
Sync actual base; create/resume Ticket branch
All Slices share this Ticket's branch
Issue remains open until verified merge
Clean exact source branch; sync base
Status: done; close Ticket; keep PR reference
Tracked follow-up edits use a new branch + PR
All Ticket PRs merged; no open blockers
Ticket Issue: behavior + nested Slice plan + current state.
One Ticket = one Issue = one implementation branch / PR.
Slices do not create separate branches or ticket Issues.
Unchanged state is not a reason for a tight retry loop.
Work on a different ready Ticket only when authorized
and ownership boundaries permit; keep dependencies intact.
update same Issues; preserve valid work
reviewed head + required checks + merge verified
